summary: Preserve Kimi EXL3 KDA checkpoint formats and padded TP heads
compatibility: Preserves default projection behavior for other quantization configurations. TP9 EXL3 serving and CUDA graph qualification are pending.
details: Keeps serialized MXFP8 Q/K/V separate from BF16 gate, factor and beta projections.
Loads partial TP head shards with zero-filled tails, including recurrent state and convolution decode weights.
Preserves source-aligned EXL3 expert extents and adds checkpoint mappings for split projections.
